name: Breadcrumb
description: Hierarchical location trail. Use Collapsed=True when intermediate levels must be condensed at narrower widths. Sizing policy: Hug Contents width with fixed standard control height.

collapsed.false: Every item is shown in full.
collapsed.true: Middle items are folded behind an overflow affordance.

states.Collapsed=False: fill card · border 1px border · radius radius/lg · text muted-foreground · type size/13

dos: Reference variables for every value; never hardcode a hex or px.
Change state through props, never by detaching the instance.
Render the current page as plain text, not a link.
Collapse the middle rather than wrapping to a second line.
whenToUse: Show where the current page sits in a hierarchy, and offer a way back up.
whenNotToUse: Step-by-step progress through a flow — use a stepper.
donts: Do not use it to record visit history — it reflects hierarchy, not the back button.

notes: Wrap in a nav with an accessible name such as "Breadcrumb".
Mark the current page with aria-current="page".
Separators are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
